actionHub.title: Generate your Career Report first
actionHub.body: Your Action Hub is woven from your Career Report — without it there's nothing personal to act on yet. Generate the report from your profile, then come back to find your tailored plan.
actionHub.primaryCta: Go to Profile to generate report

companionsCohort.title: Companions are part of a separate cohort
companionsCohort.body: Your current invite tier doesn't include Companions. Settings lists every cohort you belong to — switch or upgrade there, and Companions will appear next time you check.

companionsOptIn.title: Turn on Companions in Settings
companionsOptIn.body: Companions is opt-in. Enable it once and your matches, requests, and conversations will live here.

companionsProfile.title: Create your Companion card
companionsProfile.body: Companions matches on a short profile you control — value anchors, what you're up for, and how to reach you. Make yours in Settings and the discovery board fills in instantly.

deepDive.title: Complete Quick Dive first
deepDive.body: Deep Dive builds on the patterns Quick Dive measures. A 5–7 minute Quick Dive is enough to unlock the full 86-question Deep Dive.

postAssessment.title: Check back on {{availableOn}}
postAssessment.body: This follow-up survey opens seven days after your first post-assessment (T1), so we can measure change over a meaningful interval. Come back on the date above.

pipeline.title: Your last Deep Dive didn't finish
pipeline.body: Your assessment pipeline failed before your profile was ready. We've kept your answers — head to the dashboard and tap Retry. If it keeps failing, email deepdivecareer@outlook.com — we read every message.
